operation: On the v2 backing at the G4b-1 code tip: a seeded Show whose Group definition Pulse pair holds Clips g-a 0+2000 and g-b 3000+2000 joined by a 1 s crossfade lt-pair. Double-click the Group to isolate it, open the crossfade's Layer Transition Details, set Duration to 2.5 s (first capture), then open it again and press Reset to Cut (second capture). The third capture renders the stored v2 record (GET /api/shows) from the same run: seeded; after Duration, lt-pair 2500 ms with g-b shifted to 4500; after Reset to Cut, no Transition and g-b back at 2000, flush with g-a's end, as v1's resize and Reset shift the to-Clip.
